description: This file defines the RocksDBIterator class, which implements a key-value store iterator for RocksDB within Apache Spark's kvstore module. It manages iteration over database entries, resource cleanup, and supports features like skipping and batch retrieval.

classes.name: RocksDBIterator
classes.description: A generic iterator for RocksDB key-value store entries, supporting forward and backward traversal, skipping, and resource management.

classes.name: ResourceCleaner
classes.description: A nested static class responsible for cleaning up RocksDB iterator resources asynchronously.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements to iterate over.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the iteration.

methods.name: next(int max)
methods.description: Retrieves up to 'max' elements as a list.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: loadNext
methods.description: Loads the next valid entry, considering bounds and end markers.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a key starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: isEndMarker
methods.description: Determines if a key is an end marker.
